title: Canonical coefficient and tensor-complex transports along a further slice
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site, R a sheaf of commutative rings, a:V→U an arrow and W restriction from R_U-module sheaves to R_V-module sheaves. Given any S on C/U, T on C/V and xi:WS≅T, construct the isomorphism W^D(Q_U S[0])≅Q_V T[0] and a natural isomorphism Q_U(S tensor P|U)|V≅Q_V(T tensor P|V) for every cochain complex P of R-modules. The tensors here are ordinary tensor complexes. Use exact restriction, its canonical successive-slice comparison and the natural tensor restriction isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-slice-tensor-natural, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction], with the coefficient and complex conventions [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-model-currying]. No K-flatness is required for these ordinary-complex transports.

proof.text: Restrict S[0] using the exact-functor comparison and single-complex restriction, then apply xi. For tensor complexes apply the natural tensor restriction comparison followed by xi tensor the identity.

Map the tensor comparison to complexes, compose with the canonical equality between successive slice restrictions, and apply Q. Exactness of overMap supplies its derived factorization and makes the final comparison natural in the entire complex.
